Description: User creates a habit with a name and basic settings.
User gets habit suggestions customized to their daily activities and goals.
User picks a habit from 8 preset ideas.
User changes a habit’s settings.
User permanently deletes a habit. Requires a second tap to confirm.
User archives a habit.
User reverses a delete, archive, or check from the toast shown after the action.
User taps a habit to mark it done. It moves to Done, the completed counter and XP increase by 1.
User taps a habit each time they do it until the target is reached. It then moves to Done, the completed counter and XP increase by 1.
Habits are grouped by time of day: morning, midday, evening, anytime.
User creates a todo with a name and a date (today, tomorrow, or a chosen day).
User changes a todo’s name or date.
User deletes a todo. No confirmation required.
User reverses a todo action from the toast shown after the action.
User taps a todo to mark it done. It stays in place until the day changes. The completed counter and XP increase by 1.
User sees the habits and todos due on a selected day. Defaults to today. Each date shows a progress ring, full on a perfect day.
Summary of the user’s habit and todo progress over the past week.
Summary of the user’s habit and todo progress over the past month.
User sees overall habit progress for the week, including perfect days.
User sees overall habit progress for the month, including perfect days. Shown per habit in a GitHub-style grid.
User sees average habit progress (%) per weekday, Monday to Sunday, as a bar chart.
User sees the streak rankings for each habit.
User renames the Bulet character.
User buys Bulet accessories and streak freezes with diamonds.
Purchased accessories are stored in the closet.
Each completed habit or todo gives 1 XP. Each level requires a different amount of XP.
User earns 20 diamonds on each level up.
Streak increases by 1 when the user completes at least 1 habit that day.
User can hold up to 2 streak freezes. One is used automatically when the user misses a day.
Toggle switches the whole UI between ID and EN.
Toggle switches the whole UI between light and dark mode.
Toggle turns sound on or off.
Toggle turns reminder notifications on or off.
User downloads all habit data and logs as a JSON file.
User uploads a data file or pastes text to restore habit data and logs.
User deletes all data. Requires a second tap to confirm.
User enters an email and a verification code. After sign in, habit data and logs are saved to the cloud.
